hypotheses.claim: sensor lag or calibration is the primary source of truth-speed error
hypotheses.test: replay aligned GPS and RPM lag against real logs
hypotheses.falsifier: Reject if replay aligned GPS and RPM lag against real logs shows no improvement across at least 3 scenarios and 2 real logs

hypotheses.claim: traction intervention timing is late relative to wheelspin growth
hypotheses.test: counterfactual earlier TC onset in digital twin
hypotheses.falsifier: Reject if counterfactual earlier TC onset in digital twin shows no improvement across at least 3 scenarios and 2 real logs

hypotheses.claim: intervention slew causes driver-felt throttle jerk
hypotheses.test: counterfactual slower and faster slew comparison
hypotheses.falsifier: Reject if counterfactual slower and faster slew comparison shows no improvement across at least 3 scenarios and 2 real logs

hypotheses.claim: surface or thermal state is missing from the truth/control model
hypotheses.test: compare dry wet gravel rough and thermal drift residuals
hypotheses.falsifier: Reject if compare dry wet gravel rough and thermal drift residuals shows no improvement across at least 3 scenarios and 2 real logs

hypotheses.claim: telemetry dropout handling causes unsafe throttle reduction
hypotheses.test: inject GPS/RPM/RSSI dropouts and require TCT=1024
hypotheses.falsifier: Reject if inject GPS/RPM/RSSI dropouts and require TCT=1024 shows no improvement across at least 3 scenarios and 2 real logs
